analysis.title: The week in seven charts: Microsoft outage disrupts services worldwide
key_insights: Microsoft had a global outage on Friday morning that disrupted services across multiple regions. China was unaffected, possibly because it runs separate Microsoft service infrastructure.

Nvidia is no longer the world's largest company. Its CEO has resigned amid an ongoing investigation. The stock is 36% below its all-time high, which removed more than $2tn of market value and returned the top spot to Apple.
Nvidia shares are at their lowest level since July 2025 after a sixth straight weekly decline, the longest losing streak since 2012.
Nvidia trades at about 10x forward earnings, cheaper than Broadcom (17x), TSMC (18x), Alphabet (19x) and AMD (33x). Only Micron is cheaper at 4.3x.
Goldman expects Nvidia to honour its existing financing commitments. The open question is whether new deals get smaller, slower or more expensive if lenders ask for backstops of 25% or more.
If Nvidia pulls back from financing, neoclouds and AI labs would pay more to borrow, with CCC spreads already near the widest levels of this cycle.
Nvidia reports Q3 results on Tuesday 17 November. Syz flags Colette Kress's answer on the $500bn of commitments as the first clue on whether Nvidia will make fresh commitments.
Nvidia has no controlling shareholder. Vanguard and BlackRock hold the largest reported blocks. Jensen Huang is the largest individual holder in the 2026 proxy at a 3.41% beneficial stake.
SpaceX's connectivity revenue grew 69.5% y/y in Q3 2026, against AT&T 7.2%, T-Mobile 6.3% and Verizon 2.9%. It brought in $5.25bn of revenue and $3.49bn of adjusted EBITDA.

Starlink subscribers doubled over the period while ARPU fell from $83 to $69. The telecom incumbents generate roughly four to six times as much connectivity revenue. SpaceX has agreed to acquire nationwide low-band spectrum for Starlink Mobile.

Binance says it has fully covered the assets affected by the $6.3bn hack and published a new proof-of-reserves snapshot. Users will be able to verify balances were backed at least 1:1 once the zero-knowledge proof is generated.

risk_factors: Nvidia's CEO has resigned amid an ongoing investigation.
Nvidia may shrink, delay or reprice new financing commitments if lenders require backstops of 25% or more.

Concentrated global dependence on Microsoft services, shown by Friday's outage.
